title: Qatil Saya
desc: A police officer investigates the mystery behind unnatural deaths after taking charge of his new post at a hill station.

title: Himmatwar
desc: The son of a wealthy man leaves his family post a misunderstanding. Later, when he saves a police officer from an evil man, this results in him earning the latter's wrath.

title: Mere Sajna Saath Nibhana
desc: Kanhaiya, a poor street performer, falls in love with Chanchal, a wealthy woman. He convinces his mother to ask for her hand in marriage, but things take a turn when Chanchal's father insults her.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Ghayal
desc: Balwant Rai, a corrupt businessman, frames Ajay for the murder of his brother. Later, with no support from those close to him, Ajay takes an unlikely route to seek revenge.
